enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket. Breathe. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Breathe. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Breathe.
Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms overhead. Yawn. Turn body. Sit up on edge of bed. Rub eyes. Stand up.
Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Wash face. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk.

Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Put in laptop. Put in notebook. Zip work bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Check patient list. Pick up stethoscope. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Write notes. Walk to nurses station. Use computer. Update patient records. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Walk to patient room. Administer medication. Wash hands.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Open door. Enter apartment. Close door. Lock door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add chicken. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Save document. Close document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light.
Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lie down.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light.
Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Lie down on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Turn off light. Close eyes.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Turn to back. Stretch. Breathe. Remain still. Breathe.
